Scenario: CAP CDS model and service compile
Preconditions: Dependencies installed; source complete
Steps: Run npm run compile
Expected result: CAP model/service compile; required fields and association exist
Actual result: npm run compile completed successfully; CAP generated CDS compilation output.

Scenario: Local app starts with persistent SQLite
Preconditions: Dependencies installed; local port available
Steps: Deploy schema; start CAP; call service; restart and read same row
Expected result: CAP starts and data remains after process restart
Actual result: CAP started after db:deploy and browser data survived page refresh/re-sign-in; server process restart and post-restart read were not exercised.

Preconditions: Authenticated IT Admin; valid asset
Steps: Create Hardware/Software; read; rename; query inventory
Expected result: Valid asset persists with Available status; permitted name update persists
Actual result: Backend test created/read/renamed/deleted an unallocated asset; browser registration succeeded. Full UI inventory query walkthrough is separate.

Scenario: Reject invalid asset data and lifecycle field patch
Preconditions: Authenticated IT Admin
Steps: Try missing/invalid values, unsupported type/status, invalid dates, and lifecycle patch/upsert
Expected result: Clear error; no invalid/partial state persists
Actual result: Backend integration test rejected invalid type/status/dates, missing software expiry, forged identity/lifecycle fields, and direct upsert.

Scenario: Safe deletion with and without history
Preconditions: Authenticated IT Admin; assets with/without history
Steps: Delete both through OData; retire the historical asset
Expected result: Only asset without history is physically deleted; historical asset is retained/retired
Actual result: Backend lifecycle tests allowed delete only without history and preserved/retired historical assets.

Preconditions: Authenticated IT Admin; available asset; active employee mapping
Steps: Allocate to Alex; read asset/history
Expected result: Asset becomes Allocated; trusted assignee and one active history row exist
Actual result: Backend and browser set Allocated, resolved Alex by user ID, and created one active history row.

Preconditions: Authenticated IT Admin; allocated/maintenance/retired examples
Steps: Allocate each case, including already allocated
Expected result: Conflict/validation; original assignment/history unchanged
Actual result: Backend tests rejected duplicate/ineligible attempts and concurrent loser with consistent state/history.

Preconditions: Authenticated IT Admin; one available asset; two mapped employees
Steps: Send two concurrent allocations
Expected result: One request succeeds; one active history row remains
Actual result: Concurrent integration test recorded one success, one conflict, and one active history row.

Scenario: Return asset and preserve allocation history
Preconditions: Authenticated IT Admin; allocated asset
Steps: Return; read asset/history
Expected result: Available status, cleared assignee, dated closed history row
Actual result: Backend and browser return set Available, cleared assignee, closed the history row with business date, and preserved history.

Preconditions: Authenticated IT Admin; already returned asset
Steps: Return twice; compare state/history
Expected result: Repeated return fails without partial updates
Actual result: Backend test rejected repeated return with conflict; asset stayed Available and history stayed closed once.

Preconditions: Authenticated IT Admin; software with existing expiry
Steps: Renew to later valid date; inspect asset/compliance
Expected result: Expiry updates and compliance changes immediately
Actual result: Backend tests recalculated alerts; browser renewal succeeded and showed the new expiry.

Scenario: Reject invalid renewal and hardware license renewal
Preconditions: Authenticated IT Admin; software and hardware assets
Steps: Try past/today/non-extending date, missing ID, and hardware renewal
Expected result: Error with no expiry/allocation change
Actual result: Backend integration test rejected hardware renewal, non-extending expiry, and expiry today.

Preconditions: Authenticated IT Admin; available and allocated assets
Steps: Try retirement while allocated; return; retire; inspect history
Expected result: Allocated retirement is rejected; eligible retirement preserves history
Actual result: Backend test rejected allocated retirement, then returned and retired the asset while preserving history. UI retirement was not exercised.

Preconditions: Authenticated IT Admin; retired asset
Steps: Attempt allocation and other invalid transitions
Expected result: Invalid transitions fail and retirement/history remain
Actual result: Backend test verified retired state is retained and allocation is rejected.

Preconditions: Controlled business date 2026-09-28
Steps: Query expiry dates yesterday/today/day 30/day 31
Expected result: Yesterday expired; today and day 30 expiring; day 31 excluded
Actual result: Fixed-date backend test verified all four boundaries.

Preconditions: Legacy Software with missing expiry; new Software registration
Steps: Query alerts; attempt new Software without expiry
Expected result: Missing-date alert separate; new Software without expiry rejected
Actual result: Backend test placed legacy missing expiry in its own group and rejected new Software without expiry.

Preconditions: Hardware with warranty dates and missing date
Steps: Query summary and inspect Compliance UI
Expected result: Hardware appears in warranty category, not software licenses
Actual result: Backend and UI showed Hardware warranty separately from software license alerts.

Preconditions: Controlled date; Available, Allocated, maintenance, retired assets
Steps: Query compliance summary
Expected result: Idle after more than 30 days from latest return/purchase; others excluded
Actual result: Fixed-date tests verified day-30 exclusion, day-31 inclusion, return/purchase basis, and status exclusions.

Scenario: Employee sees own currently assigned assets
Preconditions: Authenticated Alex and Jamie with separate assignments
Steps: GET MyAssets as each user
Expected result: Each sees only their current assets
Actual result: Backend identity-scoping tests passed; browser showed only Alex's assigned laptop.

Scenario: Employee cannot read or mutate another user's inventory/history
Preconditions: Authenticated employee
Steps: Request inventory/history and try lifecycle write or broad filter
Expected result: Forbidden/no cross-user data or mutation
Actual result: Backend role tests denied inventory/history and writes; widened filter did not expose another employee's assets.

Preconditions: Authenticated Compliance Manager
Steps: Read compliance; try inventory, employees, history, writes
Expected result: Compliance readable; unrelated access denied
Actual result: Backend tests allowed compliance read and denied inventory/mapping/history/write; UI loaded alerts.

Scenario: IT Admin permissions and Employee identity validation
Preconditions: Authenticated IT Admin
Steps: Read inventory/history/mappings; allocate to enabled/invalid employee
Expected result: Admin actions allowed for valid mapped employee; invalid employee rejected
Actual result: Backend role and employee validation tests passed; browser exercised purchase/allocation/return/renewal.

Preconditions: No auth, then valid identity lacking needed role
Steps: Call protected reads/actions
Expected result: 401 unauthenticated; 403 unauthorized
Actual result: Backend HTTP tests asserted 401 and 403.

Preconditions: Inventory query service available
Steps: Use OData search/filter/order/top/skip against varied assets
Expected result: Correct bounded ordered server-side results
Actual result: Controller builds server-side OData queries and page limits; complete query/paging scenario was not exercised.

Preconditions: CAP running; Employee mock user; browser
Steps: Sign in; open My Assets; navigate detail; refresh
Expected result: Only own service data displays and persists
Actual result: Employee My Assets showed Alex's assignment only; Employee detail navigation and refresh persistence were not exercised.

Preconditions: CAP running; Admin user; demo data
Steps: Register/edit/allocate/return/renew/maintenance/retire in UI
Expected result: UI confirms lifecycle updates and retained history
Actual result: Browser exercised registration, allocation, return, refresh persistence, and renewal; edit, maintenance, and retirement UI actions remain unverified.

Preconditions: CAP running; Compliance Manager user; demo data
Steps: Sign in and open Compliance page
Expected result: Expired/expiring, warranty, missing-date, and idle groups are visible
Actual result: Compliance UI displayed all five alert groups from CAP.

Preconditions: Authenticated SAP Build/BAS session
Steps: Submit exact prompt; inspect result/files; validate
Expected result: Log matches actual prompt and output
Actual result: Exact read-only Joule prompt was submitted; result remained Thinking while indexing; no generated code/result to validate.

Preconditions: Authenticated BAS workspace
Steps: Open solution; run CAP/app; inspect live output
Expected result: BAS contribution and execution recorded
Actual result: BAS and existing AssetMaintenance project were inspected; this task app was not implemented or run in that workspace.

Preconditions: Authorized target and required HANA/XSUAA entitlements
Steps: Build MTA; deploy; inspect app/services/routes; smoke test
Expected result: Deployment and role setup recorded only on success
